articles.image_title: Pakistan: Mourners place coffins of Shiite Muslims during funeral rites, a day after a suicide bombing at a mosque in Islamabad on February 7, 2026. articles.image_title: Weibliche Genitalverstümmelung: A razor blade, used in traditional female circumcision ceremonies, sits on a pile of millet flour, which is used to stop the bleeding.
